name: Agricultural Retail Agronomy Networks
fn: 1,000-5,000 agronomists and crop advisers, with 50-200 in agronomic research and analytics
verdict: Logged — below threshold; the largest agronomic advisory workforce in the country, given away to sell fertilizer and chemistry

name: Automotive Paint Colour Formulation Research
fn: 100-300 colour scientists, formulators, and technicians globally
verdict: Logged — below threshold; an exceptional proprietary dataset given away to sell paint, which is exactly what caps the price of any tooling around it

name: Biological Control Field Advisory Teams
fn: 50-400 field advisors, entomologists, and technical staff per major supplier
verdict: Logged — below threshold; the largest advisory headcount in the industry and a genuine surveillance dataset, but the advice is given away to sell the product

name: Ingredient Applications Laboratories
fn: 500-3,000 flavourists, food scientists, and applications technologists at the largest houses
verdict: Logged — below threshold; one of the largest and best-funded research organizations in the entire sweep, existing to sell ingredients

name: Listing Marketplace Pricing Analytics
fn: 50-200 data scientists, analysts, and product staff
verdict: Logged — below threshold; excellent data, but dealers are paying for leads and the analytics ride along, which caps what the insight itself can be priced at

name: Resale Certificate & Association Document Services
fn: 50-300 document processors and support staff, above a small analytical core
verdict: Logged — below threshold; a document fulfillment business sitting on the richest association document corpus in the country and analyzing none of it

name: Softlines Testing & Quality Assurance Labs
fn: 200-2,000 lab technicians, chemists, and technical reviewers per softlines division
verdict: Logged — below threshold; the failure corpus is genuinely valuable but the invoice is a measurement, and client confidentiality blocks the cross-brand analysis that would make it insight

name: State Vehicle Inspection Program Operators
fn: 20-80 program analysts, data staff, and quality assurance engineers
verdict: Logged — below threshold; superb data against the hardest clock in the sweep, sold to a buyer set of about a dozen state contracts

name: Tax Software Content & Compliance Teams
fn: 50-300 content analysts, form specialists, and engineers
verdict: Logged — below threshold (Q1: customer buys the software, not the research)

name: Utility Efficiency Programme Implementers
fn: 100-600 programme analysts, engineers, and data staff
verdict: Logged — below threshold; the invoice is programme delivery against a savings target, so the analytics are an operating cost

name: Wholesale Auction Condition Report Operations
fn: 1,000-5,000 inspectors, condition report writers, and arbitration staff
verdict: Logged — below threshold; the arbitration-outcome join is the best condition ground truth in used vehicles, but the report is bundled into a transaction fee rather than invoiced as insight

name: Community Association Insurance Underwriting
fn: 40-200 underwriters, actuaries, and risk engineers
verdict: Logged — below threshold by two points; the analysis prices a policy rather than being the policy, but the loss corpus is the strongest in the industry

name: Refund Transfer & Advance Banking
fn: 100-500 credit analysts, risk modellers, fraud analysts, and programme managers
verdict: Logged — below threshold. Holds the only large dataset on when refunds actually arrive and which returns get delayed or offset — information taxpayers and preparers both want and neither can get — and uses it to price an advance.

name: Childcare Background Check & Screening Vendors
fn: 100-800 screening analysts, adjudicators, and compliance staff
verdict: Logged — below threshold; the deliverable is a verification rather than an analysis

name: Diagnostic Tool Coverage Engineering
fn: 100-400 coverage engineers, technicians, and validation staff
verdict: Logged — below threshold; a large, genuinely research-shaped organization whose output is bundled into hardware and subscription rather than sold as insight

name: Fleet Maintenance Management Analytics
fn: 50-200 analysts, maintenance authorizers, and data staff
verdict: Logged — below threshold; the reliability corpus is extraordinary, but the invoice is a per-vehicle management fee and the analytics ride along inside it

name: Foodservice GPO Category Analytics
fn: 50-200 category managers, procurement analysts, and data staff
verdict: Logged — below threshold; the spend corpus is exceptional and the revenue model is a rebate on purchasing, so insight is never separately invoiced

name: Mass Tort & Class Action Claims Administration
fn: 300-2,000 claims analysts, notice specialists, data staff, and programme managers
verdict: Logged — below threshold. Enormous repeatable labour, but the deliverable is an administered process against a matrix somebody else wrote, not an analysis.

name: Professional Brand Education & Technical Teams
fn: 100-600 educators, technical artists, and colour chemists per major brand
verdict: Logged — below threshold; the largest technical education workforce in the industry, given away to sell colour

name: Brokerage Research Divisions
fn: 200-800 researchers, economists, and analysts globally
verdict: Logged — below threshold; the largest research organizations in the industry, funded as a brokerage lead generator, which caps what tooling for them can be priced at
